papers.title: Cross-Stock Predictability via LLM-Augmented Semantic Networks
papers.authors: Yikuan Huang, Zheqi Fan, Kaiqi Hu, Yifan Ye
papers.summary: Two-stage: sparse candidate graph from 10-K embeddings, then LLM classifies edges by economic type (customer/supplier, competitor, common input). Key distinction: symmetric links → mean-reversion alpha; asymmetric links → lead-lag alpha. Builds on Cohen & Frazzini (2008) customer-supplier momentum.

papers.title: LLM as a Risk Manager: Semantic Filtering for Lead-Lag Trading in Prediction Markets
papers.summary: Hybrid two-stage causal screener: Granger causality identifies candidate leader-follower pairs, LLM re-ranks by plausibility of economic transmission mechanism. Outperforms stat-only baseline on Kalshi Economics markets. Methodology directly applicable to equity lead-lag pairs.
papers.note: Methodology incorporated into pairs-trading.md wiki page; no separate H-number needed (H319 already covers this approach)

papers.title: Momentum Crashes Are Optional (If You Let ML Filter Them)
papers.summary: LightGBM classifier trained on macro + technical features gates momentum strategy. Reported MaxDD reduction from 30% to 13% on US equity momentum. Feature importance: VIX, momentum portfolio trailing vol, 12-1 spread, 200d MA relative position.

papers.title: Macro Economists in the Machine: Multi-Agent LLM for Commodity Portfolio
papers.summary: Tests LLMs for commodity portfolio construction with fixed information set and rules. Assesses whether LLM judgment adds value vs. rule-based baseline. June 2026 paper — very fresh.
papers.note: Already queued as H281. Confirms commodity LLM angle is active research area.

papers.title: PortBench: Correlation-Aware Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
papers.summary: Benchmarks 10 LLM models on portfolio management. Only DeepSeek models benefit from adding full covariance matrix; 7/10 models perform better WITHOUT it. Max-Sharpe objective generally outperforms naive approaches. Key finding: covariance matrix is noise for most LLMs at portfolio construction.
papers.note: Design implication: when building H280/H209, don't pass full covariance matrix to LLM — use simple risk constraints instead
